title: checkTrackerItem
responsibility: Find and rank open or ignored Tracker item matches from supplied item rows.

inputs.name: checkTrackerItem.rows
inputs.description: The raw item rows, in the order supplied by the caller. Ignored and open results are sorted separately and capped at five.

inputs.name: checkTrackerItem.text
inputs.description: Search text used to detect an existing Tracker item.

inputs.name: checkTrackerItem.options
inputs.description: Optional agent filter and item ID to exclude. Defaults to neither filter.

inputs.name: trackerItemError.message
inputs.description: Diagnostic explaining why Tracker rejected the request.

inputs.name: trackerItemError.status
inputs.description: Response status used for the rejection. Defaults to 400.

inputs.name: trackerItemError.body
inputs.description: Optional duplicate details attached to the error for structured clients.

outputs.name: checkTrackerItem
outputs.description: Ranked matches split into ignored and open items.

errors.name: TrackerItemRequestError
errors.description: A request with invalid Tracker input carries status 400 and a compatibility message.
